verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is Warehouse Sync, which ingests data in bulk from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery or Databricks through its own API. The Events API also accepts events in batches. Both are bulk data ingestion rather than general bulk operations, and nothing shows bulk update, delete or edit actions across many records or audiences. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete/edit operations across items (users, audiences, connections), bulk actions in the UI or API beyond ingestion, limits/scale details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
